goal: Check whether the domain shop.example.com mentioned in work_history belongs to the current task
impact: Determines the target object of the technical audit and Stage 1 conclusion
allowed_actions: Inspect saved Evidence captures without duplicate network requests
done_when: Both confirming and disconfirming quotes with exact JSON Pointer links are collected

plan.hypothesis: The domain shop.example.com from work_history may belong to the current task, but without confirmation in the job post this remains a hypothesis.
plan.method: Compare work_history and description/counterevidence in the saved example-source.json capture.
plan.expected_if_true: The domain appears in the current job description or is confirmed by the same storefront.
plan.disconfirming_outcome: The domain appears only in a past contract while the current job post names no domain.
success_criteria: Both JSON Pointers are recorded: /work_history/0/feedback and /counterevidence.
limitations: A local fixture without live storefront observation does not prove domain ownership.
stop_conditions: Both fields of the local capture are verified.
